messages:
Rae Thompson: Kickoff: NimbusPay onboarding 30-min thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and initial 10-day runway. Nimbus wants a Private deployment (VPC), MFA for console, and a basic SOC2 export. Pilot goals: 99.9% uptime, 95th pct latency <250ms under expected load, and initial accuracy eval on 1k prompt samples with >92% approved outputs.

Evan Li: Ill own infra integration and can lead the smoke tests. Recommend starting on a q4 quantized model for throughput. Need their staging VPN creds and IP allowlist.

Sana Reddy: Ill run enablement (2 sessions): prompts tuning + ops runbook. Suggest dates: 5/4 16:00 UTC (prompts), 5/6 15:00 UTC (runbook).

Tom Becker: Nimbus available mornings PST 5/3-5/7. We prefer logs retention 45d for compliance, but can accept 30d for pilot. We will share KMS details. Also request a pre-signed SOC2 evidence bundle.

Rae Thompson: noted. We can set retention to 30d for pilot and produce a SOC2 export. Sana, please send invites to Tom and Priya (Nimbus PM).

Evan Li: sample smoke test command after creds:
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"nimbus-llm-q4", "input":"ping"}'
Ill attach a harness to assert latency and correctness checks. PR by EOD 4/28.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated: invites scheduled; SOC2 export queued under /onboarding/nimbus/documents.

Tom Becker: clarify rollout gate: we require >=92% approved outputs on the eval set AND 95th pct <=250ms during a 30-minute steady window. If either fails, keep flag off and run hosted fallback.

Rae Thompson: agreed. Action items: Evan: infra PR + harness + dashboard panels (due 4/28). Sana: invites & enablement agenda (sent). Rae: SOC2 export & docs (due 4/29). Tom: provide staging creds & KMS info (ASAP).

Tom Becker: creds and KMS info uploaded to vault; pinged your team. :thumbsup:

Rae Thompson: thanks everyone, will follow up with a short recap doc and reopen if outstanding after infra sync. @Evan @Sana @Tom
